title: SKE Crystal Grape Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: SKE Crystal Grape Nic Salt offers a full-bodied Grape flavour with rich, aromatic depth. The flavour captures the essence of dark, sun-ripened Grapes, delivering a sweet, slightly floral inhale with a subtle tang on the finish. There's no ice or added confectionery twist here just the pure, rounded flavour of juicy Grape from start to finish. This is a dependable fruit profile with a touch of sophistication, ideal for those who prefer single-note flavours with character. The profile stays consistent throughout, making it a great everyday vape for fans of darker fruit flavours. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod systems and vape pens. It's available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, delivering a smooth throat hit and quick, satisfying nicotine absorption. SKE is renowned for delivering bold, satisfying flavours with sleek, user-friendly design. Their Crystal Bar disposables helped set a new standard for flavour clarity and convenience, and the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range continues that legacy offering the same popular flavours in a format compatible with a wide range of refillable pod kits and MTL vape devices. With a presence in over 50 countries, SKE remains at the forefront of vaping innovation.
